claim: Verification gates are router output but their execution is unobservable across 3 independently-authored adapters; no contract or evidence field detects whether a named gate actually ran.
Phase 3 types router-failure exit codes but names no call-site obligation; harnesses can silently fall back to native model selection on constraint-violation, bypassing trust zones.
Uniform ignore-with-warning on unknown schema versions inverts fail-closed on routing.yaml trust-zone fields; the cited routing-overrides precedent has no version-check code in the actual mechanism.
decision.go already defines a half-wired PolicyHash witness field, never computed in-package; the plan builds a parallel rationale field and never mentions PolicyHash.
Phase 5 reuses the routing-overrides F2 propose/approve pattern but drops F3/F4 post-commit canary; an approved-but-bad routing.yaml edit has no automatic degradation detection.
Adjudication of f-007 vs f-013: f-007 survives; safety fields must fail closed regardless of version, sunset/ratchet applies only to the non-safety path.
The ledger's own complementary-not-contradictory self-tag on f-013/f-007 could mislead a cluster_id dedup into picking the milder framing and dropping the P1 finding.
Capability-vector provenance tags have no re-verification cadence or staleness disposition; a benchmark tag looks equally authoritative regardless of age.
The judgment provenance tag records a human-typed value with no author/date/rationale field; unattributable, indistinguishable from a later different judgment on the same axis.
Two-strikes escalation to frontier tier has no de-escalation/reset clause; the natural reading is a permanent ratchet, the exact scarce-capacity misroute the doctrine exists to prevent.
Phase 6 drift report flags drift with no defined destination, urgency, or owner, unlike Phase 5's fully-specified flow.
Phase 6 drift report is a two-witness collation step but names no tie-break rule when registry and interrank disagree.
ic route decision JSON identifies model@deployment but carries no decided_at/version-witness field to correlate evidence back to a silent same-deployment vendor model swap.
Phase 4 builds two same-author adapters (conformance by construction); no shared conformance checklist or test vectors any adapter must pass before its fail-closed claims are trusted.
